text:
Maya: Morning team — quick heatcheck. Current backlog 38 (↑3), P1s: 1 (webhook retry loop). Blockers? Macros needing update? I'm going to swap some macros for webhook escalations. TL;DR: will triage P1 first.

Liam: On it. I'm looking at the webhook retry P1 now. Repro: POST -> 5xx -> consumer requeue -> duplicate deliveries. Looks like the ack path ignores X-Idempotency header in ~50% of cases. Gathering logs.

Priya: Morning — tickets assigned: 12 (taking billing + refunds). No blockers on my side. I can spare 30m to review macros after lunch.

Jordan: I'll update the webhook macro to include clearer triage steps and an escalation timer. Draft below.

```
Title: Webhook loop - initial triage
Body:
- Symptom: repeated POST retries to customer endpoint
- Check: service logs for X-Idempotency / request-id headers
- Quick fix: ask engineering to disable requeue when X-Idempotency present
- Escalate: @oncall if retries persist for 15m
```

Maya: Added to macros PR https://github.com/redwood/support-macros/pull/72 :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: Deploy to support-macros v1.4 succeeded (05:12 UTC)

Liam: Quick ask — can someone ping #eng-runtime for a rollback of the webhook consumer? The change landed last night and matches our failing window. @Jordan, can you nudge?

Jordan: Pinged @eng-runtime. They said a rollback is possible but will take ~20-30m during low traffic window.

Ava: Queue snapshot: 38 open, avg SLA 4.8h, 6 waiting on customer. I'm pushing a temporary holding macro for the ones waiting for customer response.

Priya: I'll pick up the billing double-charge tickets (IDs in the shared doc). Also requested a review on my refund macro: https://github.com/redwood/support-macros/pull/74 — small template changes.

Maya: @Liam please add your repro logs + affected customer list to ticket #2339. Helps eng reproduce faster.

Liam: Done — ticket 2339 updated with logs and sample customer IDs.

Jordan: Macro draft updated in PR 72, added a sample placeholder for `{{first_failure_time}}` and unit tests for replacements.

Maya: Thanks everyone. One last logistic: I'm out 14:00–17:00 PT today, @Tess covering my shift. If anything P1-ey pops, escalate to incidents and tag Tess.

Tess: Got it — I have coverage. :wave:
